tools.name: search_place
tools.description: Stations, stops, landmarks, restaurants (official licence list), buildings and street addresses in Hong Kong matching the text, best first, with what each is and its coordinates. Pass near to rank a chain's branches nearest to a point.

tools.name: nearby_departures
tools.description: What's leaving now from the MTR stations, bus stops and green minibus stops around a place in Hong Kong, nearest first: each route and direction once (at its nearest stop), where it's heading and the minutes until its next two departures, live from the operators. tools.name: service_updates
tools.description: What's disrupted right now: MTR lines reporting a delay (MTR's next-train feed) and open road incidents such as accidents, breakdowns and lane closures (Transport Department special traffic news). Empty lists mean nothing is reported. plan_trip also flags these on the options they affect.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "border_crossings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
